plaatsen.tekst: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake
And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
